claim: The main-CPU SOUND TABLE is a list of priority-headed cue tables under the format header `SNDPRI,N*(REPCNT,SNDTMR,SND#) N>=1` (SNDTMR in 16 msec, END: REPCNT=0). SND-2..SND-22 pin each cue Defender's df6-1 integration reaches; excluded rows (CNSND coin, TBSND terrain-blow, LSKSND lander-suck, LGSND dead lander-grab, ST2SND/START2) are deferred or dead.
LASSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the LASER cue — the laser-fire event. Played at DEFA7.SRC:2767 (LDD #LASSND / JSR SNDLD) after LFIRE spawns a shot.
LHSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the LANDER HIT cue — the lander-hit event. Played by the KILP kill macro at DEFB6.SRC:922 (KILP 0115,LHSND).
SCHSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the SCHITZ HIT cue — the mutant-hit event (a schizoid is Defender's mutant). Played by KILP at DEFB6.SRC:625 (KILP 0115,SCHSND).
UFHSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the UFO HIT cue — the baiter-hit event (the baiter is Defender's UFO). Played by KILP at DEFB6.SRC:82 (KILP 0120,UFHSND).
PRHSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the PROBE HIT cue — the pod-hit event (the pod is Defender's probe). Played by the KILO kill macro at PRBKIL, DEFB6.SRC:118 (PRBKIL KILO 0210,PRHSND).
TIHSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the TIE HIT cue — the bomber-hit event (the bomber is Defender's TIE/mine-layer). Played by KILO at TIEKIL, DEFB6.SRC:1120 (TIEKIL KILO 0125,TIHSND).
SWHSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the SWARM HIT cue — the swarmer-hit event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:192 (LDD #SWHSND / JSR SNDLD).
LSHSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the LANDER SHOOT cue — the lander-shoot event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:581 (LDD #LSHSND / JSR SNDLD).
SSHSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the SCHITZO SHOOT cue — the mutant-shoot event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:899 (LDD #SSHSND / JSR SNDLD).
USHSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the UFO SHOOT cue — the baiter-shoot event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:37 (LDD #USHSND / JSR SNDLD).
SWSSND (SNDPRI $C0) is the SWARM SHOOT cue — the swarmer-shoot event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:269 (LDD #SWSSND / JSR SNDLD, commented SWARMER SOUND).

LPKSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the LANDER PICK UP cue — the lander-pickup (abduction grab) event. Played at DEFB6.SRC:790 (LDD #LPKSND / JSR SNDLD). LGSND 'LANDER GRAB' (:687) is a DEAD table with no call site anywhere in the tree, so the grab moment sounds LPKSND.

APSND (SNDPRI $D0) is the APPEAR SOUND cue — the enemy-appear event. Played THROUGH the APSNDV vector ($FFDD, PHR6.SRC:96) at SAMEXAP7.SRC:53 (LDD APSNDV / JSR SNDLD); the vector's data slot FDB APSND (DEFB6.SRC:2247) resolves it to this table.

SBSND (SNDPRI $E8) is the SMART BOMB cue — the smart-bomb event. Played by SBOMB at DEFA7.SRC:3183 (LDD #SBSND / JSR SNDLD) after SBDISP; it is the ONE cue a smart bomb sounds, the cleared enemies being silent.
PDSND (SNDPRI $F0) is the PLAYER DEATH cue — the player-death event. Played at DEFA7.SRC:1336 (LDD #PDSND / JSR SNDLD) on the player-death path.
RPSND (SNDPRI $FF, the top priority) is the FREE SHIP cue — the extra-man event (a replay/bonus ship). Played at DEFA7.SRC:529 (LDD #RPSND / JSR SNDLD) alongside the AUDIT of a free ship.

ST1SND (SNDPRI $F0) is the START 1 cue — sounded ONCE at game start (ST09, DEFA7.SRC:1105-1106: LDD #ST1SND / JSR SNDLD), NOT per wave; the machine loads no per-field sound. df6-1 reuses it as the wave-start cue (a logged Design Deviation).
ACSND (SNDPRI $E0) is the ASTRO CATCH cue — the astro-catch (rescue) event, when the ship catches a falling humanoid. Played at DEFB6.SRC:405 (LDD #ACSND / JSR SNDLD).
ALSND (SNDPRI $E0) is the ASTRO LAND cue — the astro-land event, when a humanoid is deposited safely on the ground. Played at DEFB6.SRC:973 (LDD #ALSND / JSR SNDLD).
AHSND (SNDPRI $E0) is the ASTRO HIT cue — the astro-hit event, when a walking humanoid is killed by hostile fire. Played at DEFB6.SRC:396 (LDD #AHSND / JSR SNDLD).

ASCSND (SNDPRI $D8) is the ASTRO SCREAM cue — the astro-scream event, when a carried humanoid is dropped and falls (a hit carrying-lander screams its passenger). Played at DEFB6.SRC:914 (LDD #ASCSND / JSR SNDLD).
